title: AIX must be configured with a default gateway for IPv4 if the system uses IPv4, unless the system is a router.
check_content:
Check the system for an IPv4 default route using command:
 
# netstat -r |grep default 
default            10.11.20.1       UG        1      1811 en0      -      -

If a default route is not defined, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Set a default gateway for IPv4 using:
# route add 0 <ip address of gateway>
VulnDiscussion: If a system has no default gateway defined, the system is at increased risk of man-in-the-middle, monitoring, and Denial of Service attacks.
